headline: Mitsotakis: The GSI project is proceeding without turbulence
summary: The foreign minister briefed political leaders on the Great Sea Interconnector project, and the prime minister said it is proceeding without turbulence. He views the three offers as a vote of confidence.
why: The Great Sea Interconnector is a planned undersea power cable linking Greece, Cyprus and Israel, a large energy infrastructure project with major financing and geopolitical implications.
